prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your original email to restore your previously created pets and items."}}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Choice Audio Preview Flow: Add interactive sound preview buttons to pet choices during selection so users can hear pet vocalizations before choosing.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:pet_vocal_preview", "label": "Listen to Pet Vocalizations", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}]}}

   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:pet_mascot_anim", "style": "rounded"}]}}
3: [finish, hint] Desktop Launch Safety Hint: Display a hint on the finish screen explaining where the desktop pet resides and how to reveal it via the system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Look for your pet on your desktop display or right-click the system tray icon anytime to manage visibility."}}
4: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Photo Quality Checklist: Integrate an interactive photo quality checklist on the photo upload screen to guide custom pet image selection.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Photo requirements: clear lighting, front facing, high resolution", "style": "emphasis"}]}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_wait_activities", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_wait_activities": {"headline": "Preparing Your Pet Desktop Haven", "body": "While your companion is being rendered, try these fun interaction tips!", "layout": "carousel", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Right-click your pet on desktop to feed or play anytime.", "style": "calm"}]}}
6: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Grid Overview Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen into a structured grid comparing standard adoption with custom pet generation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Select Your Companion Journey", "body": "Choose a pre-made pet or generate a custom companion from your photos."}}
7: [finish, wait_info] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Video: Embed a short video preview component on the final screen showing basic pet controls such as hiding, moving, and talking.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "video", "asset": "asset:desktop_controls_demo", "label": "Quick 10s Guide to Desktop Controls", "style": "rounded"}]}}
8: [choose_path, copy] Path Option Time Expectation Copy: Update headline and body copy on choose_path screen to state clear time estimates for instant vs custom paths.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Pick Your Companion Path", "body": "Choose Instant Companion for 1-minute setup, or Custom Pet Creator to generate from photos."}}
9: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Desktop Account Benefits Checklist: Switch sign-in screen to a compact layout with a feature checklist emphasizing cloud save and pet protection.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "compact", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Cloud pet sync, multi-device access, automatic pet recovery", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a helpful account recovery hint on the sign-in screen within onboarding.
Adds audio vocalization previews to the pet selection screen without violating rules.
Redesigning the adoption certificate components to only include a mascot removes the required official stamp.
Adds a desktop pet visibility hint on the home intro screen.
Adds a photo quality checklist component to the upload photos screen.
Adds a new wait activities screen before the waiting screen, which is allowed by Rule 4.
Redesigns choose path screen into a grid while preserving both adoption and custom pet creation options.
Adds a quick guide video component to the home intro screen.
Updates choose path copy with time estimates while keeping both path options and avoiding price mentions.
Redesigns sign-in screen layout with a benefits checklist without breaking any base rules.
